Container.Name: Unraid Template Sync
Container.Overview: Receives authenticated GitHub push webhooks and automatically refreshes this Unraid server's private Community Applications XML templates.
Container.Description:
Secure webhook receiver for the Lowess Unraid template catalog.
It validates GitHub's HMAC-SHA256 signature, repository, branch, delivery ID, and current webhook source network before fetching the configured public repository over HTTPS. It then force-resets the mounted checkout and mirrors Lowess/*.xml to Community Applications private templates. A startup sync recovers changes missed while the container was stopped.
Put this service behind an HTTPS Nginx Proxy Manager host and use the same high-entropy webhook secret in this template and GitHub. Restrict NPM to the current GitHub webhook CIDRs from https://api.github.com/meta. See the project README for setup details.
Container.Changes: ###v1.0.0 (2026-09-21) - Initial release with HMAC, repository, branch, delivery replay, and GitHub source-IP validation. - Added asynchronous webhook handling, startup reconciliation, and health reporting.

Config.Name: Template repository checkout
Config.Description: Existing docker-templates-unraid Git checkout. Local tracked changes and, when enabled, untracked files are discarded during sync.

Config.Name: Private template destination
Config.Description: Destination for the mirrored Lowess XML templates. Stale XML files are deleted; non-XML files are left untouched.

Config.Name: Application state
Config.Description: Stores the last known-good GitHub webhook CIDR cache.

Config.Name: Webhook HTTP port
Config.Description: HTTP port consumed by Nginx Proxy Manager. Do not expose it directly to the internet.

Config.Name: GitHub Webhook Secret
Config.Description: Required high-entropy secret shared with the GitHub repository webhook. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: GitHub Repository
Config.Description: Only webhook payloads for this exact owner/repository are accepted.

Config.Name: GitHub Branch
Config.Description: Only pushes to this branch start a sync.

Config.Name: Git HTTPS URL
Config.Description: Public HTTPS Git URL used for fetches; no host SSH keys are mounted.

Config.Name: Trusted NPM proxy CIDRs
Config.Description: Comma-separated proxy networks allowed to supply X-Forwarded-For. Narrow this to the Docker network or IP used by NPM.

Config.Name: Enforce GitHub webhook IPs
Config.Description: Dynamically enforce GitHub's current hooks CIDRs. Keep enabled in addition to HMAC validation.

Config.Name: Clean untracked repository files
Config.Description: Run git clean -fd after reset, matching the previous script. Disable only if this checkout intentionally contains untracked files.

Config.Name: Sync on container start
Config.Description: Reconcile templates at startup to recover from missed webhook deliveries.
